alex-hormozi.platform_fit: Direct-response business short form built around blunt hooks, one big problem, and a tactical payoff.
voice_traits: Start with the claim, not the setup
Use blunt, second-person pressure
Keep one core idea per clip
Translate insight into a concrete business consequence
End with a sharp takeaway instead of a soft fade-out
hook_patterns: You're not getting [result] because of [hidden reason].
The problem isn't [obvious thing]. It's [deeper thing].
If I had to do [goal] again, I'd do this first.
Here's why [common behavior] keeps failing.
script_rules: Front-load the problem in the first sentence
Use contrast words like but, instead, or actually to create tension
Name the hidden tax or cost of doing nothing
Land on mechanism plus payoff, not vague motivation

More than one major claim in 30 seconds
